CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
